source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: The ACMG recommends vitamin D supplementation in individuals with NF1 to reach sufficient serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations, although published evidence of efficacy is lacking.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). ACMG practice resource recommendation derived by work-group consensus from the literature and the authors' expertise; the authors state evidence is limited. Capped at 2 (expert_opinion).
independence_flags: expert consensus recommendation; not an empirical finding
